Container.Name: MC-Router-UI
Container.Overview:
Minecraft reverse-proxy web UI (built on itzg/mc-router) with Cloudflare DDNS and Crafty Controller integration. mc-router and the web UI run together in a single container via supervisord.
IMPORTANT — networking: this template defaults to Host networking. Health checks and the Crafty integration connect directly from this container to your Minecraft/Crafty backends; on the default Bridge network, Docker cannot resolve other containers by name (e.g. "crafty"), which is the most common cause of routes never showing "Reachable". Only switch to Bridge if you place this container on the same custom Docker network as every backend it needs to reach, or always use LAN IPs instead of container names as your route backends.
Container.Description: Minecraft reverse-proxy web UI with Cloudflare DDNS and Crafty Controller integration.

Volume.Name: Docker Socket (optional — enables auto-discovery of Docker-labeled routes)

Variable.Name: MC_PORT
Variable.Description: Minecraft ingress port (internal, exposed directly on the host with Host networking).

Variable.Name: API_PORT
Variable.Description: mc-router's own REST API port. Internal only — do not expose this externally.

Variable.Name: MC_ROUTER_API
Variable.Description: mc-router API endpoint used internally by the web UI. Leave as-is unless MC_ROUTER_API/API_PORT were customized.

Variable.Name: ADMIN_USERNAME
Variable.Description: Admin account username. Created on first start only.

Variable.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Variable.Description: Admin account password. CHANGE THIS. Only used to bootstrap the account on first start — later changes made in the UI are not overwritten by this value on restart.

Variable.Name: SECRET_KEY
Variable.Description: Optional session secret key. Leave blank to auto-generate and persist one.

Variable.Name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
Variable.Description: Optional. Cloudflare API token (DNS:Edit permission) for automatic DNS records and DDNS.

Variable.Name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
Variable.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Zone ID. Alternative to Zone Name below.

Variable.Name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_NAME
Variable.Description: Optional. Cloudflare zone/domain name (e.g. example.com) — used to resolve the Zone ID automatically if not given above.

Variable.Name: DDNS_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Variable.Description: How often (seconds) to check for public IP changes and update DNS.

Variable.Name: CRAFTY_URL
Variable.Description: Optional. Crafty Controller base URL, e.g. https://192.168.1.50:8443. Prefer a LAN IP over a Docker container name — see the Overview note on networking.

Variable.Name: CRAFTY_API_KEY
Variable.Description: Optional. Crafty Controller Bearer API token.

Variable.Name: CRAFTY_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY
Variable.Description: Set to "true" ONLY if CRAFTY_URL is on your trusted local network and uses a self-signed certificate (the Crafty default). Without this, Crafty API calls fail TLS verification and never connect. Leave blank/false if Crafty is reachable from outside your LAN.

Variable.Name: CRAFTY_SERVERS_DIR
Variable.Description: Path (inside this container) to Crafty's servers directory, for direct server.properties editing. Matches the "Crafty Servers Directory Mount" volume above.
